intent: Phase 6: make the migration documentation match the code and stop the two drifting apart again. Warrant: the lock-book's enforced contract that migration history is a record, not a description; the defect is doc and test drift, v13 and v11 claimed against v30 real. Source row WO-0027. Acceptance: (1) docs/MIGRATION.md:57, :79 and :104 corrected to the v30 head; (2) a head constant minted in src/lib/db-schema.ts, chosen because that file is unmocked by tests/jest.setup.ts lines 116 to 133, is already imported by the upgrade test and is exempt by name in design-lint, and asserted equal to the last applier's gate, NEUTRAL_COLUMN_NAMES_SCHEMA_VERSION, which T-0007 reserves, with the three hardcoded 30s at tests/unit/run-migrations-upgrade.integration.test.ts:128, :169 and :192 tied to it, strengthened and never weakened; (3) the going-forward rule written into docs/MIGRATION.md, that a schema change is a new numbered .sql plus a version-gated applier exec'ing it, appended to the hand-wired order in the db entry file, with the 4 readFileSync appliers and 3 pure-TS appliers recorded as the historical exceptions, the ladder quirks documented, no v6, no v10, 007 and 008 inert markers, and shipped migrations immutable; (4) operator ruling D6 recorded here, that session-sync's guarded lazy self-heal is deliberate and sanctioned, so the design-lint comment and the file agree. Done when MIGRATION.md matches the code and the doc and test cannot drift apart again. Merge gate: the upgrade-path test. Tier proposal R1, anticipated factor size-threshold from derived signal diff-size. Worth stating because a reader expects a migration task to route higher: this task adds no numbered .sql and changes no schema, so the migration-path detector behind schema-change should stay quiet, and if the diff does reach a migrations path the gate will rule R2 and the ceremony rises with it.
